1 Year Warranty
Warranty Policy OnePlus phones purchased on amazon.in come with a limited warranty of one (1) year starting from the date of delivery. Unless otherwise specified, this warranty covers the hardware components of the Product as originally supplied and does not cover, or partially covers, software, consumable items, or accessories, even if packaged or sold together with the Product. This warranty is only redeemable within the original country or region of purchase. The limited warranty does not cover: i. Defects or damage resulting from accidents, neglect, misuse or abnormal use; abnormal conditions or improper storage; exposure to liquid, moisture, dampness, sand, or dirt; unusual physical, electrical or electromechanical stress. ii. Scratches, dents and cosmetic damage, unless caused by OnePlus. iii. Defects or damage resulting from excessive force or use of metallic objects on the touch screen. iv. Devices that have the serial number or the IMEI number removed, defaced, damaged, altered or made illegible. v. Ordinary wear and tear. vi. Defects or damage resulting from the use of the Product in conjunction or connection with accessories, products, or ancillary/peripheral equipment not furnished or approved by OnePlus. vii. Any physical feature defects or damage resulting from improper testing, operation, maintenance, installation, service, or adjustment not furnished or approved by OnePlus. viii. Defects or damage resulting from external causes such as collision with an object, fire, flooding, dirt, windstorm, lightning, earthquake, exposure to weather conditions, theft, blown fuse, or improper use of any electrical source. ix. Defects or damage resulting from cellular signal reception or transmission, or viruses and other software problems introduced into the Product. x. Repair conducted by un-official repair centres.

About this item

  • Supercharged by Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 (Antutu 1.17 million+): Engineered for snappy-smooth performance, OnePlus Nord CE6 unleashes up to 144 FPS gameplay in optimised titles. Experience up to 6 hours of steady BGMI sessions with consistent, high-speed performance that never compromises.
  • Segment's Fastest Touch Response: Built for ultra-responsive gameplay, OnePlus Nord CE6 delivers industry-leading 3200Hz instant touch sampling rate, ensuring faster inputs, precise control, and a competitive edge in every move.
  • 8000mAh “2.5+ Days" Battery: Experience 10 hours of BGMI, 17.5 hours of GPS, or 30 hours of streaming on a single charge. It doubles as a power bank to charge anything via 27W reverse charging, while 80W SUPERVOOC gets you back in action with hours of use from just minutes of charging.
  • 144Hz 1.5K AMOLED Display: Enjoy ultra-fluid scrolling and gameplay with a 144Hz refresh rate for seamless interaction. From being crystal-clear in direct sunlight (1800 nits HBM) to being gentle on your eyes at night (3840Hz high-frequency PWM), this display is designed for unmatched clarity, day or night.
  • 4K Front and Back Clarity: 50MP 4K main camera with dual-axis OIS for stable, detailed shots and videos. 32MP 4K selfie camera with autofocus and 90° wide-angle capture for perfect groufies, even in low light. Elevate your photos with OnePlus AI like AI Portrait Glow, AI Perfect Shot, AI Eraser, AI Unblur, and more.
  • Military-grade Durability with IP66,68,69,69K: Certified with the industry's most complete IP ratings, the Nord CE6 is built to resist deep immersion, hot water, and high-pressure jets. It has passed rigorous american military-grade standards, proven to survive being burnt, frozen, salt-corroded, and dropped over 25 times onto steel surfaces for total reliability.
  • Smoothness for 6 Years, Built to Last: Powered by the latest OxygenOS 16, the Nord CE6 stays fast and smooth for work, study, and play. With a Rated A system fluency and 6-year battery health, your phone is engineered to deliver a "like-new" experience for years to come.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we do not use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things such as how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Absolute Battery Monster & Blazing Fast Charging – The King of Practicality!
    I recently switched to the OnePlus Nord CE6 after a brief stint with the Nothing Phone 3A Pro (and having unluckily lost my Nord CE4 before that). While the Nothing phone was aesthetically brilliant with great cameras, it heavily missed the mark on daily battery endurance and charging speed for my usage. Moving back to this OnePlus device has been an absolute game-changer. Here is my breakdown after putting the device through its paces (According to my experiences and usage patterns) : 🔋 Battery Life: Elite Tier Endurance The battery performance on this phone is a literal joke—in the best way possible. On day one alone (while the phone was still indexing and setting up accounts), I hit an unbelievable 8 hours and 31 minutes of Screen-On Time (SOT), and I still had 26% battery remaining! The system estimated another 9 hours of standby on Balanced Mode. The overnight idle drain is practically flat. You can easily clear a 24-hour cycle and push past 10+ hours of heavy SOT before needing a plug. ⚡ Charging: The Return of True Fast Charging Having to charge my previous 5000 mAh phone twice every 36 hours was becoming a chore. Getting back to the legendary high-speed SUPERVOOC charging ecosystem feels incredibly liberating. Top-ups are ridiculously quick, giving you absolute peace of mind without having to constantly hunt for a wall socket. 📱 Software & Convenience Features Coming back to OxygenOS feels highly optimized. Little daily conveniences work perfectly here. For instance, taking a scrolling screenshot happens smoothly in a single action, unlike other custom UIs that clunkily force you to take multiple manual captures just to stitch an image together. The system launcher and background management are fluid and snappy out of the box. 📦 Storage Efficiency (8GB/128GB Variant) While I am stepping down to 128 GB after using 256 GB phones for a few years, managing it is completely effortless if you manage your data dynamically. With streaming being so seamless and offloading data to a laptop being a breeze, 128 GB is more than enough for current essential usage and apps, especially if you aren’t heavily into hoarding photography. Final Verdict: If you value raw battery longevity, minimal idle drain, lightning-fast charging speeds, and a reliable, snappy daily user experience, the OnePlus Nord CE6 is an absolute home run. Highly recommended! Shall update after a month with a more specific review.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Absolute Battery Monster & Blazing Fast Charging – The King of Practicality!
      Reviewed in India on 18 May 2026
      Colour: Fresh BlueSize: 8GB+128GB
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I recently switched to the OnePlus Nord CE6 after a brief stint with the Nothing Phone 3A Pro (and having unluckily lost my Nord CE4 before that). While the Nothing phone was aesthetically brilliant with great cameras, it heavily missed the mark on daily battery endurance and charging speed for my usage. Moving back to this OnePlus device has been an absolute game-changer.

      Here is my breakdown after putting the device through its paces (According to my experiences and usage patterns) :

      🔋 Battery Life: Elite Tier Endurance

      The battery performance on this phone is a literal joke—in the best way possible. On day one alone (while the phone was still indexing and setting up accounts), I hit an unbelievable 8 hours and 31 minutes of Screen-On Time (SOT), and I still had 26% battery remaining! The system estimated another 9 hours of standby on Balanced Mode. The overnight idle drain is practically flat. You can easily clear a 24-hour cycle and push past 10+ hours of heavy SOT before needing a plug.

      ⚡ Charging: The Return of True Fast Charging

      Having to charge my previous 5000 mAh phone twice every 36 hours was becoming a chore. Getting back to the legendary high-speed SUPERVOOC charging ecosystem feels incredibly liberating. Top-ups are ridiculously quick, giving you absolute peace of mind without having to constantly hunt for a wall socket.

      📱 Software & Convenience Features

      Coming back to OxygenOS feels highly optimized. Little daily conveniences work perfectly here. For instance, taking a scrolling screenshot happens smoothly in a single action, unlike other custom UIs that clunkily force you to take multiple manual captures just to stitch an image together. The system launcher and background management are fluid and snappy out of the box.

      📦 Storage Efficiency (8GB/128GB Variant)

      While I am stepping down to 128 GB after using 256 GB phones for a few years, managing it is completely effortless if you manage your data dynamically. With streaming being so seamless and offloading data to a laptop being a breeze, 128 GB is more than enough for current essential usage and apps, especially if you aren’t heavily into hoarding photography.

      Final Verdict:

      If you value raw battery longevity, minimal idle drain, lightning-fast charging speeds, and a reliable, snappy daily user experience, the OnePlus Nord CE6 is an absolute home run. Highly recommended!

      Shall update after a month with a more specific review.

      I’ve been using the OnePlus Nord CE6 as a heavy user, and honestly, this phone has impressed me a lot in daily usage. The UI is super smooth, clean, and optimized really well. Everything feels fast and fluid.

      The BGMI experience is very, very impressive. Initially, I faced some issues, but after turning OFF the Touch Reflex Chip option, the gameplay became much smoother and responsive. I play BGMI around 2 hours daily, and the performance is excellent for long gaming sessions.

      Battery backup is also good enough for heavy usage. However, one complaint I have is the charging time. It takes around 1 hour 15–20 minutes to fully charge, which feels a bit high compared to expectations.

      Talking about the camera, it surprised me a lot. My previous phone was the Realme GT 6T, and honestly, I found the camera quality on this phone better in many situations.

      There are some small cons too. For example, WhatsApp filters are currently not working properly, but I think OnePlus will fix this in future updates.

      Please don’t get influenced by negative comments saying this phone is not up to the mark. For day-to-day life, gaming, multitasking, and overall usage, this phone is really good. I’m a software engineer and a heavy user, and I’m fully impressed with this device.

      1 out of 5 stars
      Extremely disappointing – One of the worst OnePlus phones I have used in 10 years
      Reviewed in India on 8 August 2026
      Colour: Fresh BlueSize: 8GB+256GB
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I have been a OnePlus user for nearly 10 years, and OnePlus has always been one of the brands I trusted for a smooth, reliable and hassle-free smartphone experience. I have used and recommended OnePlus phones for years.

      Unfortunately, the OnePlus Nord CE6 5G (8GB RAM + 256GB, Fresh Blue) has been a completely different experience.

      This is honestly one of the most disappointing OnePlus phones I have ever purchased, and for the first time in nearly a decade, this phone has made me seriously reconsider buying a OnePlus device again.

      1. Heating issue during normal usage

      The phone gets noticeably warm during regular usage. I am not talking about heavy gaming or extreme workloads.

      The heating happens during normal day-to-day activities, which is disappointing for a phone with a modern chipset and a large battery.

      A smartphone at this price should be able to handle basic tasks without becoming noticeably warm.

      2. Phone suddenly hangs while using it

      The most frustrating issue is that the phone suddenly becomes unresponsive/hangs while I am using it.

      At times, the phone simply does not respond properly, and I have to wait for it to recover. This is extremely irritating when you are doing something important.

      With 8GB RAM and 256GB storage, I expected smooth multitasking and reliable performance. Instead, I am experiencing random freezes and interruptions during normal usage.

      3. Fingerprint authentication fails during payment

      This is one of my biggest concerns.

      While trying to make payments through payment gateways/apps, the fingerprint authentication does not work properly. The fingerprint lock/authentication sometimes fails when I actually need it.

      This is not a minor inconvenience. Today, smartphones are used for UPI payments, banking, online shopping and other financial transactions. If biometric authentication does not work reliably during a payment, it becomes a serious usability and trust issue.

      The fingerprint sensor may work in some normal unlocking situations, but my experience during payment authentication has been disappointing.

      4. Frequent app crashes

      Another major problem is frequent application crashes and unexpected app behaviour.

      The issue is not limited to one particular application.

      For example, while using Google Maps, I have experienced situations where the application does not work as expected. Maps is one of the most basic and commonly used applications on a smartphone, so having problems while using it is extremely frustrating.

      I have also experienced apps becoming unresponsive or closing unexpectedly.

      5. Not the OnePlus experience I expected

      What makes this even more disappointing is the fact that I am a long-time OnePlus customer.

      I bought this phone expecting the same smooth OxygenOS experience and reliability that I have associated with OnePlus for years.

      Instead, I am facing:

      - ❌ Heating during normal usage

      - ❌ Random hanging/freezing

      - ❌ Frequent app crashes

      - ❌ Google Maps not working as expected

      - ❌ Fingerprint authentication issues during payments

      - ❌ Overall unreliable day-to-day experience

      These are not features I am complaining about. These are basic smartphone functions that I expect to work properly.

      My message to OnePlus

      I genuinely hope OnePlus takes feedback like this seriously.

      I have been loyal to the brand for almost a decade, and I have recommended OnePlus phones to friends and family because of my previous experiences.

      But the Nord CE6 has changed my perception of the brand.

      I understand that every individual device can potentially have a manufacturing defect or software issue. However, as a customer, I should not have to deal with freezing, application crashes, heating and payment authentication problems on a new smartphone.

      I would strongly recommend OnePlus investigate these issues through software updates and, where necessary, provide proper service/support for affected customers.

      Final verdict

      I would not recommend the OnePlus Nord CE6 based on my personal experience.

      The specifications on paper may look impressive, but specifications are meaningless if the phone cannot provide a stable and reliable everyday experience.

      For a long-time OnePlus customer like me, this is particularly disappointing.

      I am giving 2 stars only because there are some good aspects of the phone, but the basic reliability issues I am experiencing significantly affect my overall experience.

      OnePlus, after almost 10 years of being your customer, this is the first phone that has made me question whether I should buy OnePlus again.

    • Supercharged by Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 (Antutu 1.17 million+): Engineered for snappy-smooth performance, OnePlus Nord CE6 unleashes up to 144 FPS gameplay in optimised titles. Experience up to 6 hours of steady BGMI sessions with consistent, high-speed performance that never compromises.
    • Segment's Fastest Touch Response: Built for ultra-responsive gameplay, OnePlus Nord CE6 delivers industry-leading 3200Hz instant touch sampling rate, ensuring faster inputs, precise control, and a competitive edge in every move.
    • 8000mAh “2.5+ Days" Battery: Experience 10 hours of BGMI, 17.5 hours of GPS, or 30 hours of streaming on a single charge. It doubles as a power bank to charge anything via 27W reverse charging, while 80W SUPERVOOC gets you back in action with hours of use from just minutes of charging.
    • 144Hz 1.5K AMOLED Display: Enjoy ultra-fluid scrolling and gameplay with a 144Hz refresh rate for seamless interaction. From being crystal-clear in direct sunlight (1800 nits HBM) to being gentle on your eyes at night (3840Hz high-frequency PWM), this display is designed for unmatched clarity, day or night.
    • 4K Front and Back Clarity: 50MP 4K main camera with dual-axis OIS for stable, detailed shots and videos. 32MP 4K selfie camera with autofocus and 90° wide-angle capture for perfect groufies, even in low light.
